# Load Libraries

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: true

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
```

# Data Upload

```{r}

# the list used passed QC
sample_list <- here("results_for_analysis",
                    "sample_list_QC_passed.txt")

sample_list <- readLines(sample_list)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-virulencefinder

virulence_finder_path <- here("results_for_analysis",
                              "virulencefinder",
                              "virulencefinder_summary.xlsx")



virfinder_exoenzyme  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_exoenzyme_database")
virfinder_toxin  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_toxin_database")
virfinder_hostimm    <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_hostimm_database")
virfinder_overview  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "Detailed_overview")
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview <- virfinder_overview |>
  rename(
    sample              = `Sample`,
    hit_database        = `Hit database`,
    virulence_factor    = `Virulence factor`,
    identity            = `%Identity`,
    query_hsp_length    = `Query/HSP length`,
    contig              = `Contig`,
    position_in_contig  = `Position in contig`,
    protein_function    = `Protein function`,
    accession_number    = `Accession number`,
    coverage            = `Coverage`,
    hit_id              = `Hit ID`,
    position_in_reference = `Positions in reference`
  )
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview |>
  filter(virulence_factor == "splA") |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes( x = identity)) +
  geom_bar()
```
